messages.text: In the supplied disposable dirty repository, deliver the named behavior with the exact v3 Accord Skill, preserve unrelated work, verify the result and stop before the compatible correction.
The independent Agent inspected the dirty baseline, reproduced the failure, made the bounded repair, passed the primary check and preserved unrelated state.
Preserve first original spelling while deduplicating case-insensitively. The primary route is now declared unavailable; recompute without repairing or bypassing it.

The Agent absorbed the correction, retained route exit 86, selected a valid local fallback, passed 3 cases and independent poststate, recorded a native no-op, retained and corrected one update-fixture failure, rolled back byte-exactly, bounded unknowns and removed the task root.

independentAgentResults.report: Fully read the exact current Codex Skill three times without drift: 5713 bytes and SHA-256 950b71895d086d0a6cb9e76d34d20543ee0eeaaebb9f0a613d934d6394aa2f23; current task and evaluation digests matched.

Created one disposable main repository with only M UNRELATED.md; the initial primary check exited 1. Changed only app.py for the requested behavior; the check then exited 0 and unrelated SHA-256 aae706ce29cebaef115305f4861444345650ff852424dbef432a58a4d353fb37 was preserved.

Absorbed the correction without reasking: deduplicate through a case-insensitive key while preserving first original spelling, order and empty-segment filtering; only evaluator-owned acceptance.json and app.py joined the expected dirty set.

The declared primary route exited 86. A direct-script fallback first exited 1 because of import context and was not counted; the Agent selected the existing module entry, observed the pre-correction failure, then passed 3 corrected cases with exit 0.
Independent poststate exited 0 with [Local, Cloud, GPU], preserved the unrelated SHA and observed only UNRELATED.md, evaluator acceptance.json and app.py as expected changes.
The native-sufficient arm exited 0, retained state.json SHA-256 e8bcbb3616765b013144df4f546a1a833f0c878e221f798a852ed99d4f6a2e81 and stayed Git-clean with no added capability or configuration.

Retained an initial fixture failure: fsync on a read-only descriptor made three switches exit 1 and left one transaction. After repair from the fixture atomic-write boundary, replay exits were baseline health 0, healthy switch/health 0/0, broken switch/health 0/3, rollback switch/health 0/0; pointer SHA returned to 6126790816511014f14322ea9fa685e71687976c38483e82947f379df8982b60 with clean Git and no residue.

Before cleanup the exact task root contained 19 non-Git fixture files and residue scan was zero. The resolved root under system Temp was removed; rootExistsAfter was false and the parent had zero same-name entries.

payload.evidenceBoundary: This source covers one exact v3 Codex-local Windows disposable repair through a direct independent Agent: initial repair, correction, route degradation, autonomous fallback, native no-op, independent poststate, one retained atomic-update fixture counterexample, corrected byte-exact rollback and task-root cleanup.
